t_advice_summary_textbox.text: At first you might think clicking on the colours works but later it changes. Then you think about the colour of the baskets, some coliurs give more. But don't stress its just a game.

vb_textbox.text: I think the correct option depends on the colour of the gnome, the size of its hat, what the multiplier is AND whether that gome is on the left or the right. I think its a combination of all of those. I tried just colour, then colour and size of hat but I couldn't correctly guess the best choice. It takes a while to get you head around it but don't stress, it's only a game :)
